oracle: scipy.spatial.Delaunay / ConvexHull on the float32 sites (exact in float64)

tolerances.triangleCount: exact: T = 2n - 2 - h, h = ConvexHull vertex count (collinear hull points excluded)
tolerances.triangleSet: exact set equality of sorted vertex-id triples when generalPosition is true: no coplanar points and every adjacent opposite vertex strictly outside the circumcircle, checked with fractions.Fraction; otherwise only the count is compared
tolerances.emptyCircle: exact BigInt arithmetic on the float32 inputs in the spec (checkTriangulation)
